I needed something that could hold pretty much everything and keep things organized. The thing I like about this organizer is that it spins, which makes it really easy to quickly find what I'm looking for. I was surprised just how much it could hold! The only stuff I couldn't place in it were my tall bottles of hairspray and mousse, but I cleared up pretty much 95% of the

I got this for my daugher who is 12 for Christmas.  Her dresser had so much clutter and this organizer was perfect.  She loved it and couldn't wait to organize!!!!  This was delivered all put together, it spins as well and that is great too, and is amazing everything this organizer can hold.  This is extremely well made, not cheap looking at all and was definately worth the money paid for it.

reviews.t: Super cute and effective cosmetic organizational unit!
reviews.x: This is a nice piece to organize the many products I have. From perfumes to make up lotions medicines... My items for nicely and it a cute piece added a nice touch to my space. Very chic!! I posted a before and after picture! Despite other reviews the U it I received is very sturdy and hold a lot of items!

This product has made my life much easier.  It's sturdy and easy to use, and exactly as advertised.  I recommend it to anyone who is looking for something to organize their bathroom counter space.  The only slight downside is that many of my taller products are too tall even for the lower compartments.  I may have to start buying shorter products.
This literaly fit all my make up and i finally have space on my vanity!! GREAT Quality as well.... I recommend this big time for make up collecters or organizing freaks like me heheheh enjoy

Needless to see, after 2 months the item BROKE.  It didn't fall, no blunt force was put on it, nothing out of the ordinary. I walked into my room and the plastic piece that keeps the items from falling off was split in 3 pieces. This is a very nice product and can really be used for men or women and even children. Really helps organize my stuff and gets my wife off my back! thank you!

I bought this because I was tired of my bathroom counter always looking so cluttered, and it also took more time to clean my counters off when I cleaned my bathroom.  This organizer allowed me to declutter my counter, and also made it easier to clean the space that is now uncovered.  It came already assembled. The only thing I don't like, is some of the material that holds the items in, is a bit flimsy, but none of it has broken.  This is a win win buy, for those who like organization and easy c

I love this on my vanity, it is pretttttttty expensive in price, but it shipped in perfect condition and rotates to perfection. Sometimes for convenience "hey just pay." I just wish the bottom shelf were a little taller so I could put my equate cetaphil lotion in and have finger room to pump it. So if that tells you approx the height, second shelf is good for perfumes, deodorant. Top hairspray or candle. Bottom too short for spray.. Hope this helps? ;)

reviews.t: LOVE THIS! Only regret: Wish I found it waaaaaaaaaay Sooner!!!!
reviews.x: Love! Love!  Love this!  Where has it been all my life! Now I can finally "find and use" all my awesome anti-aging products!  Not to mention my master bath counter looks all nice and organized! Cuz If I can't SEE IT...or FIND IT...I seem to not use it. And I pay waaaaaaaay to much good money for all my products. Keeping them in drawers is just NOT the same as SEEING them when you want to use them. Now all my Awesome Skin Care and Cosmetics are easy to find and apply! SO this is a Must Ha

Was exactly what I was looking for, but didn't know it until I saw it online.  Thought it was a bit expensive (I live on a pension), and have noticed that the price has dropped since I purchased it, but I still feel it was money well  spent as it has allowed me to declutter my bathroom vanity area.  The pictures provided by your web site are not misleading at all, in that you can cram an unbelievable amount of make-up products into this carousel, and clearly see and access them all.  This is a v

Was searching for something to help organize my hair and make up products that started taking over my husband side of the counter. Came across this and decided to give it a try my husband was happy no longer had to share his portion of his counter space. I loved it so much bought another one for him to put his colognes and shsving items etc. Now we way have way more space and stuff not spread all over the counter. Great buy.

Over-priced but a real life saver. My counter top was beginning to look like a Sephora shop. Not only do I have cosmetics in the countertop, but in the drawer and in the linen closet and below sink storage which I detest. So I got this and put all the everyday stuff I use in it. Clean countertop now. Yay! Looks so much better and is so much more convenient. Actually the price wasn't bad, but the shipping was over the top.

It felt it was a bit expensive, but it serves it's purpose well. Now all my perfumes are where I can see them and they don't take up the whole counter space.  I've put only perfume bottles on it and they can be heavy, but the organizer spins very smoothly  even with all the bottles on in it. It seems pretty sturdy so far.  I've only had it for a month but I hope it lasts a long time.

I just received my cosmetic organizer from Amazon, I just love it! was worth the money I put into it, holds so much perfume too! I had a few other bottles or remainders left, but, for the price I paid, I would order others too. very sturdy, and I love how it rotate too. I would recommend it to anyone who needs a storage  good job on arriving fast too.

My cosmetics were all over my vanity area and I just did not have any room to function.  I love this organizer to the fullest.  It is what was needed to give more room with ease access to everything I used daily.
Perfect for organizing our teenage daughter's bathroom.  She doesn't have a lot of counter space and her bathroom always looked messy before.
This was EXACTLY what I was looking for!  And I still have one of the big compartments and one of the small compartments open.
I would have liked to have an edge on the top tray.  It works perfect and it fits in the corner of my counter.

I was going to put this on top of my dresser, but I decided to use it in the kitchen instead. It makes a great holder for onions, garlic, lemons, and other such things that used to pile up in a basket (and often get bruised or rotten) on my kitchen counter. With this organizer, I can keep all my produce separate, keep an eye on which things might need to be used right away, and access them easily -- all in a tidy corner of the kitchen.

reviews.t: so this thing is pretty dang expensive...
reviews.x: But I just got it in the mail and put all my/ my boyfriend's products in this thing and there is actually still room to spare. It can hold a lot! I already know 7000% this is going to make my life easier. I'm surprised I've never seen a toiletry/ cosmetic organizer like this before!!  Seems so common sense now that I have it!  This thing takes up a bit of room but what it frees up in counter space/ peace of mind is well worth it!!
This was a horrible product. It fell apart as soon as I put it together. It's made of plastic and not sturdy at all! Save your money. It is not worth $60. I wouldn't even pay $10 for this product.
It was an okay product, but it's not what I was looking for. Not to mention it is very overpriced! ($60?) . I returned this item.
Ok, so I understand that this might be a good product! But I am not willing to pay more than 30 dollars for a piece of plastic!

reviews.t: Bought this for my teenage daughter - it really helps ...
reviews.x: Bought this for my teenage daughter - it really helps organize all of her cosmetics & the swivel keeps everything in sight.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how much the organizer holds, saying it fits all their makeup, perfumes, and beauty products.
Many reviewers highlight the spinning/rotating feature as a convenient and smooth way to access items.
Several reviewers describe the organizer as sturdy and well made.
A common complaint is that the product is expensive or overpriced.
Some reviewers note that taller products do not fit well in the compartments.
